name: Omarchy Music Player
author: Symon Baikov
description: The only Music Player for Omarchy you ever need! YouTube Music, Apple Music, Spotify, Deezer, SoundCloud, Mixcloud, Audius, your own files and music server, 50,000 radio stations and podcasts in one bar widget and a player window, played by mpv without a browser: an AI Mix made from what you listen to, lyrics in time, chords for learning a song, Peak mix, downloads.

barWidget.description: Click to browse your music and control playback; right-click to play / pause; middle-click for the next track.

schema.label: Browser to read login cookies from
schema.description: Browser you're signed in to YouTube Music with: chromium, brave, chrome, firefox, vivaldi, edge, opera, a profile such as "brave:Profile 1", or a Firefox-fork profile folder such as "firefox:~/.config/zen/<profile>". It doesn't need to be running. Chromium-based browsers' cookie keyring is taken from their --password-store flag; add "+gnomekeyring" or "+kwallet6" to set it yourself. Use "none" for public playlists only.

schema.label: Use cookies for playback
schema.description: Turn on only if private uploads or members-only tracks fail to play. Off is faster and avoids sign-in checks.

schema.label: Show track title in the bar
Show cover art
schema.description: Cover art is YouTube's own track thumbnail, loaded from i.ytimg.com.

schema.label: Repeat
schema.description: Off, repeat the playlist, or repeat one song. The repeat button in the panel cycles and saves this.

schema.label: Autoplay recommendations
schema.description: When the queue runs out (repeat off), keep playing songs YouTube Music recommends for the last one.

schema.label: Fade in (seconds)
schema.description: Each song starts quietly and rises over this many seconds. 0 is off.

schema.label: Fade out (seconds)
schema.description: Each song fades away over its last seconds. 0 is off.

schema.label: Fade on pause (milliseconds)
schema.description: Pausing fades the song away over this long, and playing again brings it back the same way. 0 pauses at once.

schema.label: Transitions
schema.description: Peak mix: at a song's climax, crossfade into the next song's climax, like a DJ. Downloads the songs' audio to the cache to mix them.

schema.label: Backup mirrors
schema.description: When a song won't play from YouTube by any of its clients, get it from independent YouTube mirrors (Invidious, Piped). They see the song's ID, never cookies or the login.

schema.label: Your own mirrors
schema.description: Optional, e.g. "invidious:https://inv.example.org piped:https://pipedapi.example.org". Empty: the healthiest instances from the projects' public directories.

schema.label: Check for updates
schema.description: Once a day, and right away when songs stop playing, git-fetch this plugin's repository to see whether a newer version is out. The panel then offers to update.

schema.label: Download folder
schema.description: Where downloaded songs go. The download screen's folder picker sets it.

schema.label: Download with cover
schema.description: Embed the cover in downloaded files (MP3, M4A, FLAC) and show it in Downloads.

schema.label: SoundCloud profile
schema.description: Your SoundCloud name or profile link, for the SoundCloud tab (likes and playlists).

schema.label: Deezer profile
schema.description: Your Deezer profile link or number, for the Deezer tab (favorites and playlists).

schema.label: Spotify app Client ID
schema.description: The Client ID of your own app at developer.spotify.com (Spotify requires one per person, and Premium). Redirect URI: http://127.0.0.1/callback.
